g.text: Economic order quantity balances annual ordering and holding costs

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Continuous EOQ with constant demand, instantaneous replenishment, no shortages, and constant costs. Relevant annual cost DS/Q+HQ/2 excludes constant
purchase cost. Q* is not rounded to an implementable pack size; integer/lot restrictions require comparing feasible quantities. Average inventory is Q/2
